purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Ponorogo

queries.query: Ponorogo Indonesia official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry
queries.result: Found the official Geoportal Palapa Ponorogo, an integrated local-government geospatial portal, and the official ATR/BPN ATLAS portal. No search result established a public parcel feature endpoint for Ponorogo.

queries.query: Ponorogo parcel tanah peta kadaster GIS resmi pertanahan
queries.result: Found the official Geoportal Palapa Ponorogo, local spatial-planning map, and ATR/BPN sources. No public cadastral parcel response for Ponorogo was established.

registryEvidence.basis: The official Geoportal Palapa identifies the Ponorogo local government geospatial custodian and exposes a public CSW catalog. The catalog and official pages establish a local geospatial portal, but not a public cadastral parcel layer.

officialSources.observation: Official Geoportal Palapa landing page; JavaScript app identifies the local government geospatial portal.
Public configuration names Geoportal Palapa Kabupaten Ponorogo, operator Dinas Komunikasi Informatika dan Statistik, and Kabupaten Ponorogo coverage.
Official national ATR/BPN geospatial portal; inspected public catalog exposed seven datasets, including national/other-area layers, but no Ponorogo parcel layer.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Ponorogo local-government geospatial portal and national ATR/BPN portal as described by first-party metadata.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No city-bounded cadastral parcel feature response was retrieved. Local CSW records were RTRW and transport datasets, not parcels.

remainingUncertainty: The absence of a retrieved parcel response does not establish citywide absence. The official viewer may require additional client-side routes, protected service access, or a non-public cadastral workflow. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe owner/address fields were used.
